obligations.text: The backend never grants authority: it supplies logits or a classified failure only, every supplied value is model-derived, and no output, embedding, cache entry or setup result is authorization or an input fact.

Every behavior-affecting input (checkpoint, graph, tokenizer, preprocessing, truncation, pooling, precision, runtime version and settings, operators, heads, labels, text templates, limits, cost and tolerance) is in the `rustev.embed-linear/1` manifest, whose digest is the artifact identity; a mutable name, alias or path is never an identity.

The crate performs no network access and no download at build, setup or inference; it reads only host-supplied absolute paths, verifies every byte it uses against the manifest before use, and refuses a missing, oversized or mismatched artifact with a typed code.

The descriptor declares exactly the operations and options of the bundled heads, output `logits` only and determinism `tolerance`; no `rank`, no label outside a head's trained options, no distribution or calibration claim.
Cancellation is acknowledged `stopped` only when the backend has established that the run ended; otherwise `unconfirmed`, and the worker slot stays occupied until the run ends.
Repeatability is declared as a tolerance measured under recorded conditions; no bitwise or cross-platform claim is made beyond what the feasibility record measured.

No inference dependency enters the workspace until the feasibility record passes stages 1 to 3 for at least one platform; a platform is supported only when all four stages pass for it, and a refusal is recorded, never hidden.

An embedding cache hit supplies exactly the bits a miss computed in the same process for the same artifact, principal handle and token sequence, never crosses a principal handle, and is refused on a platform without measured in-process bitwise repeatability.

Builds of the Node binding, the service and the facade without `local-embed` contain no crate of the local inference runtime family, and the boundary check refuses that family outside the backend crate except through an optional dependency on it.

record.summary: The first local model backend, `backends/rustev-backend-embed-linear/`: an ordinary `DecisionBackend` that embeds projected text with a frozen, host-provisioned sentence encoder run by ONNX Runtime through `ort`, and answers `classify`, `proposition` and `rubric` with logits from an externally produced, identified task-specific linear head. One canonical `rustev.embed-linear/1` manifest binds checkpoint, graph, tokenizer, preprocessing, truncation, pooling, precision, runtime, heads, labels, cost and tolerance into the artifact identity. Implementation is gated by a staged feasibility record (`rustev.embed-feasibility/1`) that passes or refuses each selection of #69 against measured limits before any inference dependency lands. No network, no download, no training, no provider; repeatability is a declared tolerance, not bitwise. Optional `local-embed` features in the Node binding, the service and the facade, and an opt-in in-process embedding cache. Amends spec 001 only by adding a local inference runtime family and one placement rule to the boundary check. Ratified (A-28) under R-36, which amends R-17 for this spec; R-43 authorizes the feasibility stages and pins the revision that ships an ONNX graph; implementation is pending.
